author: rozorshackdon
quote: ​Overzealous developers tried to shove way too much into this game, making it so resource-intensive that it feels more like an unstable operating system than an actual game due to all its bloated underlying subsystems. Between the heavy performance bottlenecks, rough physics, and slow errand-simulator pacing, it completely fails to justify its inflated 10/10 hype. Once the launch wave dies down and players move on, the studio won't be able to sustain the massive overhead required to keep this thing afloat long term. The bigger they are, the harder they fall.
